storyCards.headline: Wanna Be A Baller: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Lil' Troy's "Wanna Be A Baller" reached #70 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Wanna Be a Baller" is a single by American hip-hop artist Lil' Troy featuring Fat Pat, Yungstar, Lil' Will, Big T and H.

It was released in 1999 as the second single from his debut major label studio album Sittin' Fat Down South.

The song peaked at number 70 on the Billboard Hot 100 music chart.

The song peaked at #70 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 12 weeks on the chart.
